content.rendered:
Parents of students in the Sherwood School District may access several online information systems.

For questions regarding login credentials or to obtain a login for a particular system, please contact the main office of your student’s school.

  • Canvas  – Course material, syllabus, daily class agenda (Grades 6-12).

Here are links to guides on how to use Canvas as a parent/guardian:

  • Viewing calendar information in Canvas
  • Viewing course content in Canvas
  • Managing notifications from Canvas
  • Viewing Canvas in another language
  • Resetting a Canvas password
  • Video: How to use the Canvas Parent app
  • ParentVUE -View grades, attendance, schedules (grades 6-12); pay fees (grades PK-12).
